6. **Compile Results**

```sql
WITH base_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.country_name,
        t.calendar_year,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        s.prod_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as monthly_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN countries c ON cu.country_id = c.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_name = 'France'
        AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020, 2021)
        AND s.channel_id IN (SELECT channel_id FROM channels WHERE channel_total_id = 1)
        AND s.promo_id IN (SELECT promo_id FROM promotions WHERE promo_total_id = 1)
    GROUP BY c.country_name, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number, s.prod_id
),
product_month_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        country_name,
        calendar_year,
        calendar_month_number,
        prod_id,
        monthly_sales
    FROM base_sales
    WHERE calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
),
joined_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        a.country_name,
        a.calendar_month_number,
        a.prod_id,
        a.monthly_sales as sales_2019,
        b.monthly_sales as sales_2020
    FROM product_month_sales a
    JOIN product_month_sales b 
        ON a.prod_id = b.prod_id 
        AND a.calendar_month_number = b.calendar_month_number
        AND a.country_name = b.country_name
        AND a.calendar_year = 2019 
        AND b.calendar_year = 2020
),
projected_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        country_name,
        calendar_month_number,
        prod_id,
        sales_2020,
        sales_2019,
        (sales_2020 - sales_2019) / sales_2019 as growth_rate,
        sales_2020 * ((sales_2020 - sales_2019) / sales_2019) + sales_2020 as projected_2021_sales
    FROM joined_sales
),
with_currency AS (
    SELECT 
        p.country_name,
        p.calendar_month_number,
        p.prod_id,
        p.sales_2020,
        p.sales_2019,
        p.growth_rate,
        p.projected_2021_sales,
        COALESCE(c.to_us, 1.0) as exchange_rate,
        p.projected_2021_sales * COALESCE(c.to_us, 1.0) as projected_2021_usd
    FROM projected_2021 p
    LEFT JOIN currency c ON p.country_name = c.country AND p.calendar_month_number = c.month
)
SELECT 
    calendar_month_number,
    AVG(projected_2021_usd) as avg_projected_monthly_sales_usd
FROM with_currency
GROUP BY calendar_month_number
ORDER BY calendar_month_number
```
